prompt: In which year did California experience its second instance of wildfires burning more than 2 million acres, destroying scores of homes and other buildings?
answer: California’s second instance was **2021**, when wildfires burned about **2.57 million acres**—following the record **4.3 million acres burned in 2020**—and destroyed thousands of structures.
